verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented docs or llms.txt are a fair ask for any web-facing service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no sign of either. The only first-party probe shows the host meeting a keyless agent with a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) even on robots.txt, so no agent-readable documentation was reachable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
